title: Cold rebuild: the parameterized search
summary: Rebuild FindProducts with a parameter from memory, no hints.

steps.title: Cold rebuild
body: You fixed **FindProducts** in *SQL injection, and why parameters end it*. Write it again from an **empty editor**.
The tests are the ones you passed: UNION, `OR '1'='1'`, the hidden product, and the real O'Clock lamp.
If you get stuck, go back to the lesson and try again tomorrow. This check, plus the boss, proves the module.

steps.prompt: Which part of `SELECT name FROM products ORDER BY {sort} LIMIT {n}` can be a parameter?
options: Only `n`, the value; `sort` is a column name and needs an allow-list

steps.title: Rebuild FindProducts cold
prompt: Write `List<string> FindProducts(SqliteConnection db, string q)`: the names of products with `hidden = 0` whose `name` contains `q`, sorted by name, with `q` as a **parameter**. The table is `products (id, name, hidden)`.
